name: Anthony Palumbo
bottom_line: The core biography and the bail-reform record check out. Most record claims are undated or unnamed, so several can't be pinned down, and one origin claim conflicts with press reporting.
findings: The site is largely unchanged since 2022 (© 2022 footer, "this year alone" votes), so its record claims are undated and some describe the 2022 session.
"Lifelong resident of Suffolk County" conflicts with a Riverhead News-Review profile saying he was born in Brooklyn and grew up in Patchogue; Wikipedia lists Brookhaven as his birthplace.
The first-time homebuyer law is real (the Southold Community Preservation Fund exemption he sponsored with Sen. LaValle), but it passed in June 2014, not 2013.
"Passed more bills than any other Republican Senator" and a first bill saving "over $2,500 annually" give no year or bill, and no record of either was found.
page_issues: Footer reads "© 2022 Palumbo for Senate"; issue text refers to votes "this year alone" with no year.
Two different campaign email addresses appear on the home page.
No bill numbers, dates or sources anywhere on the site.
